SELECT b.instance_id, d.cruise_result, f.dict_note AS cruiseResultName, b.end_time, d.picpath, d.identify_result, k.dict_note as 'identifyResultName', (CASE WHEN ISNULL(e.mete_name)AND ISNULL(g.inspection_name)AND ISNULL(h.preset_name)THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(e.mete_name)AND ISNULL(g.inspection_name)THEN h.preset_name WHEN ISNULL(e.mete_name)AND ISNULL(h.preset_name)THEN g.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(g.inspection_name)AND ISNULL(h.preset_name)THEN e.mete_name WHEN ISNULL(g.inspection_name)THEN CONCAT(e.mete_name,' /',h.preset_name) WHEN ISNULL(h.preset_name)THEN CONCAT(e.mete_name,' /',g.inspection_name) END) AS cruise_name
FROM t_cruise_point_instance a LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail b ON a.instance_id = b.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_data_result d ON b.cruise_result_id = d.cruise_result_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business f ON d.cruise_result = f.dict_code AND f.col_name = 'cruise_result' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business k ON d.identify_result=k.dict_code and k.col_name='identify_result' LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete e ON a.device_mete_id = e.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection g ON a.cruise_id = g.inspection_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset h ON a.cruise_id = h.preset_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result c ON b.task_result_id = c.task_result_id where a.device_id = #{deviceId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND a.device_mete_id = #{deviceMeteId,jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY b.end_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.end_time, d.result_num, b.cruise_type, h.dict_note as cruiseTypeName, i.c_type, a.mete_name FROM ( t_std_devicemete a LEFT JOIN ( t_cruise_point_instance b LEFT JOIN t_dict_business h ON b.cruise_type = h.dict_code AND h.col_name = "cruise_type" ) ON a.device_mete_id = b.device_mete_id ) LEFT JOIN ( ( (t_cruise_task_result_detail c LEFT JOIN t_cruise_data_result d ON c.cruise_result_id = d.cruise_result_id) LEFT JOIN (t_cruise_result i LEFT JOIN t_dict_business j ON i.c_type=j.dict_code AND j.col_name="plan_type") ON c.task_result_id=i.task_result_id ) ) ON b.instance_id = c.instance_id WHERE a.device_mete_id = #{deviceMeteId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and c.end_time between #{startDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and #{endDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and b.cruise_type=#{cruiseType,jdbcType=INTEGER} and i.c_type=#{cType,jdbcType=INTEGER} ORDER BY c.end_time ASC
